Bart Ehrman is one of the best-known scholars of the New Testament, a former believer whose textual studies led him out of his faith. With Danny Jones, the ancient religion expert discusses the secret gospels, the writings the early church excluded, and his account of where the historical Jesus can and cannot be found.

Ehrman explains how scholars date texts, spot edits, and rebuild what the first Christians actually believed before doctrine settled. Jones asks the questions his audience brings, including the conspiratorial ones, and Ehrman answers them with a teacher's patience and a skeptic's edge. Little here is fringe; the disputes are the real ones inside biblical scholarship. The episode gives listeners the mainstream critical case on Jesus and the gospels, from its most famous living presenter.
